checks.name: teams with no members count zero
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.team_member_summary where member_count = 0 and handled_members = 0

checks.name: counts and first join are what they were before the refactor
checks.sql: with e as (select t.team_id, count(m.member_id) as members, count(h.member_id) as handled, min(m.joined_on) as first_joined from raw.teams t left join raw.members m on m.team_id = t.team_id left join raw.handles h on h.member_id = m.member_id group by 1) select count(*) from main.team_member_summary s join e using (team_id) where s.member_count is distinct from e.members or s.handled_members is distinct from e.handled or s.first_joined_ts is distinct from e.first_joined

checks.name: no member was dropped to make the build pass
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from raw.members) - (select sum(member_count) from main.team_member_summary)

checks.name: handles of members the roster does not have are not counted
checks.sql: select (select sum(handled_members) from main.team_member_summary) - (select count(*) from raw.handles h join raw.members m using (member_id))

workspace_checks.name: the vendor's raw.members.joined_at is still an integer
workspace_checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'raw' and table_name = 'members' and column_name = 'joined_at' and data_type = 'INTEGER'

workspace_checks.name: the intermediate is deployed on dev
workspace_checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'main' and table_name = 'int_team_members'

workspace_checks.name: the refactored mart is deployed on dev with every member counted
workspace_checks.sql: select (select count(*) from raw.members) - (select sum(member_count) from main.team_member_summary) + (select count(*) from raw.teams) - (select count(*) from main.team_member_summary)

workspace_checks.name: the mart deployed on dev reads the intermediate
workspace_checks.sql: select count(*) from main.team_member_summary s full join main.int_team_members i using (team_id) where i.team_id is not null and (s.team_id is null or s.member_count is distinct from i.member_count)
